QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is off by default (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`), and so is its backend, `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (`:2196`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that both threading macros (THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD) are off by default in the shipped header, so a default build defines neither.
